يعتقدون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَقِدُونَ (yaʕtaqidūna) /jaʕ.ta.qi.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# يُعْتَقَدُونَ (yuʕtaqadūna) /juʕ.ta.qa.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
